name: syncLISData
shortDescription: Integrates with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS) to retrieve and update lab results associated with patient medical records.
description:
Overview

Integrates with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS) to retrieve and update lab results. This function is typically triggered by an event or a scheduled job to fetch new lab results and associate them with the corresponding patient medical records.

Intended use

Invoked by an event listener or a scheduled job to synchronize lab results from an external LIS system.

Logic

  1. Receive event parameters, typically including patientProfileId or a lab order ID.
  2. Call the external LISSystem API (e.g., ctx.service('LISSystem').get_lab_results(patient_id)) to retrieve lab results.
  3. Process the retrieved lab results and create or update MedicalRecord entries (e.g., recordType: 'lab_result') for the patient using ctx.data.create or ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the integration event using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return success or error status.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • PatientProfile

External Services

  • LISSystem
